import sys, random, itertools, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp_tests')
from harness import ok

def brute_force(qids, cost, matrix, pids):
    pairs = [(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2)
             if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in qids)]
    n=len(qids)
    best=(10**9,10**9)
    # iterative over all subsets with early pruning by cost
    covers=[frozenset((a,b) for a,b in pairs if matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b]) for q in qids]
    target=frozenset(pairs)
    costs=[cost[q] for q in qids]
    for r in range(n+1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), r):
            c=sum(costs[i] for i in combo)
            if c>=best[0]: continue
            u=frozenset()
            for i in combo: u|=covers[i]
            if u==target:
                if (c,len(combo))<best: best=(c,len(combo))
    return (0,0) if not pairs else best

random.seed(11)
for trial in range(12):
    np_=random.randint(3,8); nq=random.randint(10,14)
    profiles=[{'id':'P%d'%i,'max_aliases':random.randint(0,4),'cname':random.choice(['follow','stop']),'wildcard':random.choice(['rfc','off','one-label'])} for i in range(np_)]
    names=['n%d.test.'%i for i in range(4)]+['x.y.test.','*.test.','deep.sub.test.']
    queries=[{'id':'Q%02d'%i,'name':random.choice(names),'type':random.choice(['A','CNAME','TXT','AAAA']),'cost':random.randint(1,20)} for i in range(nq)]
    zones=[{"origin":"test.","records":[
        {"owner":"*.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"end.test."},
        {"owner":"end.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.5"},
        {"owner":"leaf.block.test.","type":"TXT","data":"e"},
        {"owner":"*.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"198.51.100.2"},
        {"owner":"n0.test.","type":"AAAA","data":"2001:DB8::1"},
        {"owner":"n1.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"n2.test."},
        {"owner":"n2.test.","type":"TXT","data":"tt"}]},
       {"origin":"sub.test.","records":[{"owner":"deep.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"203.0.113.9"}]}]
    doc={'zones':zones,'profiles':profiles,'queries':queries,'observations':[]}
    res=ok(doc)
    pids=sorted(p['id'] for p in profiles); qids=sorted(q['id'] for q in queries)
    matrix={}
    for run in res['runs']:
        matrix.setdefault(run['query'],{})[run['profile']]=(run['rcode'],frozenset((a['owner'],a['type'],a['data']) for a in run['answer']))
    cost={q['id']:q['cost'] for q in queries}
    bc,bn=brute_force(qids,cost,matrix,pids)
    d=res['diagnostic']
    assert (d['cost'],d['count'])==(bc,bn),(trial,d,(bc,bn))
    pairs=[(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2) if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in qids)]
    for a,b in pairs:
        assert any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in d['basis'])
    print(trial,'ok',bc,bn,d['basis'])
print('BIG BASIS OK')
